scientific_integrity: The probability, moment criterion, and logarithmic coefficient are proved analytically. The accompanying finite tests are independent reproducibility diagnostics and are not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform jitter at exactly three periodic grid nodes; degree-one trigonometric exactness, infinite-precision weights, and noise variance only. No assertion for greater node counts or other perturbation laws. At alpha=1/2 almost-sure distinctness suffices but expected squared weights diverge.
title: Sharp positivity and logarithmic noise barrier in three-node perturbed trigonometric quadrature
